Production Glossary · 07/50 · planning

Animatic

Definition

Animatic is a timed edit of storyboard material that tests pacing, duration, transitions and basic audiovisual structure. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align planning decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.
